description_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE – EXHIBITION BUILDING!! 🏙️ 1+1 Apartment for sale in Gjergj Fishta Boulevard, Tirana This modern apartment offers an excellent opportunity for residence or investment in one of the most elite and sought-after areas of Tirana. ✨ Property Details: • Total Area: 88.61 m² • Net Area: 66.63 m² • Layout: 1 bedroom, 1 living room with kitchen, 1 bathroom • New construction, in the division phase - possibility to customize it according to your taste • Modern architecture and quality works 📍 Location: Gjergj Fishta Boulevard - elite area, just a few minutes from the center, with high access and surrounded by institutions, schools, businesses and daily services. 💎 A perfect choice for those looking for quality, comfort and a strategic position in the heart of the capital.
